messages:
marta: NewGate wants a performance run for their card-tokenization path. Requirements: sustained 750 qps for 20m, microbursts 15k qps for 8s (3 bursts), p95 < 150ms, p99 < 300ms. Also need an approx cost uplift for burst minutes vs steady and brief writeup for their security team. Can someone own runbook + cost?

dave: I can take the runbook + instance sizing. Will need an ops lead for execution. Prefer Tue night or Wed early morning.

leila: I can execute. Proposed test plan: 1) smoke 10m @ 250 qps 2) ramp to 750 qps steady 20m 3) bursts 3x8s @ 15k qps spaced 90s. Collect traces and token timings. Use dedicated pool with pre-warm and prefix cache.

sam: model/seq details? avg payload ~ 90 tokens, 95pct under 200 tokens. Recommend model: redwood-tokenizer-4b-q8 for primary, redwood-7b for control. Quantized weights to int8.

marta: security note: NewGate requires KMS envelope encryption and audit log export for the test. They also want network egress diagram.

ops-bot: infra: reserved-pool "ng-poc-1" created at 4876543222 by ops-bot

dave: autoscale plan: min_shards=3, target_latency=120ms, scale_up_step=+2, max_shards=12. For bursts allow instant scaling via burst_policy to avoid queuing. We'll cap throughput per shard to 2k qps to size properly.

leila: loadgen snippet (locally run from our cluster):
```
rl-load --endpoint https://api.redwood.example/v1/tokenize \
  --qps 15000 --concurrency 1500 --duration 8s --shape bursts,count=3,spacing=90s
```
Also a steady run: `rl-load --qps 750 --duration 20m`

sam: measurement: collect per-request timings, token-level decode timings, CPU/GPU utilization, queue times, scale events. We'll compute p50/p95/p99 and tail heatmaps.

marta: cost ask: provide two numbers: incremental cost for the 20m steady window and extra cost for the 3 burst events (including extra reserved capacity + pre-warm). Billing needs a 1-line summary for the prospect.

dave: quick sketch: steady 750 qps for 20m ~ baseline compute X (will fill actual numbers after instance selection). Bursts (3x8s @15k) will drive ephemeral scale to ~12 shards for ~24s total including spin-up = ~ +Y% for test window. I'll produce a spreadsheet.

leila: checklist for run night: 1) reserve pool and attach HSM/KMS 2) push quantized model to pool 3) pre-warm caches 30m prior 4) ensure tracing on 5) on-call (dave) available for rollback 6) smoke at 200 qps 45m beforehand.

ops-bot: artifact: ng-poc/runbook_4876543210.md uploaded to /ci/artifacts/ng-poc at 4876543275

leila: small gotcha: tokenization flow includes a downstream DB call for masking; we'll stub DB to avoid external variability. Confirming with Tal.

tal (newgate): yes please stub DB responses for the test. We'll provide a sample dataset and key rotations for HSM access. Wed night works for us.

marta: owners: runbook + cost = dave, run exec = leila, security + KMS signoff = marta. I will draft the one-paragraph cost summary for sales. Expect shared doc by EOD.

dave: will post instance sizes + exact $ numbers in the shared sheet by 16:00.

leila: logging config I'll use: trace-level=info, sample_rate=1.0 for bursts, persist traces to /tmp/ng-traces and upload to drive.

marta: thanks all. final note: please keep messaging minimal to prospect — share only the summary and the sanitized logs. We'll coordinate the security brief separately. :rocket:
